result.decisionNotes: The image should be indoors, the angel should be hovering beautifully dressed. The shot should be from across the room. We see Mary looking toward the angel, but not being able to see her face. She’s sitting on her legs to the side since she was awaken from sleep. The light is coming from the angel. Mary is a bit surprised and startled. She is a 16 year old girl. You can only partially see the side of her face. Make the pose natural snd the angel one hand palm forward saying do not be afraid
